title: Tech Domain Roadmap Generator
summary: A Streamlit-based tool that generates personalized technology learning roadmaps using classical ML recommenders (Decision Trees, KNN, Random Forest). One of its additional model scripts instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata object to generate synthetic tabular data as an alternate modeling approach.
evidence: additional_models/gan.py:14-65 imports CTGANSynthesizer from sdv.single_table and instantiates model = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata=metadata, epochs=500, ...)
needs: unclear how gan.py's synthetic output is actually used in the main roadmap app, since it's in an 'additional_models' folder separate from core logic
